# PhysicsPose

> **Kind:** component · **Registry:** both · **Folder:** [`src/physics/`](../folders/src-physics.md)
> **Source:** [`src/physics/physics_sys.h`](../../../src/physics/physics_sys.h)

## Summary

The last two simulated poses of a dynamic Jolt body.

## Description

Emplaced (emplace_or_replace) by RigidBodySys on every entity whose RigidBody is Motion::Dynamic, right after its Jolt body is created, with both poses set to the Transform's position and rotation. PhysicsSys (host) and PhysicsStepSys (worlds) shift position/rotation into prev_* and read the new pose from Jolt after each step. PhysicsSys then writes Transform = mix/slerp(prev, current, alpha) for every Transform + PhysicsPose entity; PhysicsStepSys writes Transform = current. Viewers (WorldView, SphereView, roller players) interpolate world bodies between prev and current. World-space metres and unit quaternions. It is NOT removed when the RigidBody is removed (only when the entity is destroyed); on the host a leftover PhysicsPose keeps overriding the Transform with the frozen last pose. Not registered in the scene component registry.
